property_summary: For any deposited balance, withdrawAll() must successfully drain the entire balance leaving address(c).balance == 0; the mutant's extra 1-wei withdrawal exceeds the drained balance and reverts.

For its owner, withdrawAll() always completes successfully (emptying the balance, including the zero-balance case); the mutant's extra 1-wei withdrawal always reverts because the balance has already been fully drained.
For any caller and any contract balance, withdrawAll reverts exactly when the caller is not the owner; the mutant reverts even when the owner calls, breaking the rule.

For any owner and any deposit/reentry amounts, after withdrawAll() succeeds the contract's remaining balance equals exactly the single re-entrant redeposit amount r made during the owner's receive hook (address(c).balance == r); the mutant's extra 1-wei withdrawal triggers a second re-entry, leaving balance == r + r != r.

For any deposit of v wei by any actor, a successful owner withdrawAll() must credit the owner exactly v wei (and succeed); the mutant's extra 1-wei withdrawal drains past the balance and reverts, crediting 0.

For any admissible amount, calling withdraw(amount) as the owner transfers exactly `amount` wei out of the contract, so address(c).balance decreases by exactly `amount`; the mutant transfers one wei less, leaving the contract's balance one wei too high for some amount.
For any amount v >= 1, if the contract holds exactly v wei, calling withdraw(v) as owner sends out exactly v wei, leaving address(c).balance == 0; the mutant sends v-1, leaving 1 wei behind.

For any amount v the contract is funded with, a successful owner call withdraw(v) must send out exactly v wei, leaving address(c).balance == 0; the mutant sends v-1 (leaving 1 wei) or reverts outright on v==0.

For any admissible amount v>=1, a successful owner call withdraw(v) transfers exactly v wei out of the contract, leaving address(c).balance reduced by exactly v; the mutant sends v-1, leaving 1 wei behind (and reverting entirely on v==0).

For any amount v, if the contract is funded with exactly v wei, a successful owner call withdraw(v) empties the contract (address(c).balance == 0); the mutant sends v-1 wei, leaving 1 wei behind (or reverting on v==0).

For any admissible input, calling withdraw(v) on the reference C decreases address(c).balance by exactly v and, when v is strictly less than the balance, leaves a nonzero remainder; the mutant ignores v and drains the full balance, so for some v < balance the resulting balance is 0 instead of balance-v.

For any admissible funding amount and any withdrawal value strictly below it, withdraw(v) must leave the contract with exactly amount - v wei (a nonzero remainder); the mutant ignores v and drains the full balance, leaving 0.

For any funding amount and any withdrawal value not exceeding it, withdraw(v) must leave the contract with exactly fund - v wei; the mutant ignores v and drains the whole balance, leaving 0 whenever v < fund.
